evals.name: execute-sequential-tdd-milestone-refactor

The developer writes assertions transcribed from the acceptance criteria, implements, raises those assertions to test-conventions.md itself (no `qoq test` dispatch — a subagent can't dispatch), proves the work runs with the project's own test:one and build, and hands back the changed-file list. It never invokes the qoq CLI. THE ORCHESTRATOR then dispatches `qoq fix` scoped to that list — the gate — and commits exactly that ticket's files on PASS; a FAIL re-dispatches the developer with the digest and spends one of its three attempts. Once each ticket reaches done or blocked it reports the outcome back with scripts/estimate.mjs --record, using the ticket's own tags, stack and the tier the plan assigned (not the tier that finally delivered it), the attempts actually spent, and its own attribution call — estimation-miss when the ticket was what the plan said it was, scope-expansion when the developer found work nobody knew was there.
